provenance.assertion: After 'Capture issuer, receipt and end date', proceed to 'Preserve challenge or extension deadline' when 'termination received'.
After 'Preserve challenge or extension deadline', proceed to 'Check form and service' when 'deadline position recorded'.
After 'Check form and service', proceed to 'Classify termination type' when 'formal review complete'.
After 'Classify termination type', proceed to 'Check arrears cure preconditions' when 'arrears termination'.
After 'Classify termination type', proceed to 'Check separate family-home service' when 'family-home ordinary termination'.
After 'Classify termination type', proceed to 'Screen stated reason and good-faith concerns' when 'no special precondition branch'.
After 'Check arrears cure preconditions', proceed to 'Screen stated reason and good-faith concerns' when 'arrears preconditions assessed'.
After 'Check separate family-home service', proceed to 'Screen stated reason and good-faith concerns' when 'family service assessed'.
After 'Screen stated reason and good-faith concerns', proceed to 'Assess extension evidence' when 'extension relevant'.
After 'Screen stated reason and good-faith concerns', proceed to 'Collect type-specific evidence' when 'no extension branch'.
After 'Assess extension evidence', proceed to 'Collect type-specific evidence' when 'hardship factors recorded'.
After 'Collect type-specific evidence', proceed to 'Prepare challenge, extension or settlement' when 'evidence collection closed'.
After 'Prepare challenge, extension or settlement', proceed to 'Record termination outcome' when 'outcome recorded'.
